# Wallpapers

> Original wallpapers by Jon Bailey. Full resolution, no account, free.

## What this is

A download site. The newest wallpaper opens the large view. Most loved is labeled on the main shelf.

## Facts

- No account
- No payment
- The download is the original file
- Download all saves every wallpaper and counts a save of each one
- The number at the top is the sum of the download count listed once on each wallpaper
- Share on a picture copies a link to that wallpaper
- The large view opens on the newest wallpaper. A current limited edition piece follows it, then the main set. Swipe, or use Previous and Next, to move through them
- Cowboy Bebop is a separate section of Grok Bot desktop wallpapers in a jazz-noir colony. It stays out of the main shelf. Its newest piece opens the large view while it is the newest on the site
- Akira (1988) is a separate section of Grok Bot desktop wallpapers in a late-1980s megacity at night. It stays out of the main shelf. Its newest piece opens the large view while it is the newest on the site
- Final Fantasy 7 is a separate section of Grok Bot desktop wallpapers. It stays out of the main shelf. Its newest piece opens the large view while it is the newest on the site
- Limited edition is a separate section of spooky scary Halloween Grok Bot desktop wallpapers
- Veil & Vane Award Winners and Mace Windu are separate sections at the bottom of the page. They stay out of the main shelf and out of the large view
- Most recent and Most popular reorder each section. Most popular follows download counts
- Some wallpapers also have a phone-shaped file, and that download is full resolution too
- The picture on the page is a preview
- Most loved is the wallpaper with the most loves
- Ties go to the wallpaper with more downloads, then to the newer one
- Newest is the wallpaper added most recently

## Canonical

https://wallpaper.jonbailey.xyz/
